description: The whole relation graph of a workspace in one call — what is connected to what, one entry per relation with both sides resolved (database and field name on each). Useful for structural work: adding a field, moving a database, planning a migration, or answering "what would break if I deleted this". [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_relations"]

database.description: Only relations touching this database (name, qualified slug, or id).

space.description: Only relations touching this space (name, slug, or id).
